snippet.title: She Hunts Early Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
She Hunts is an exploration focused narrative action-adventure game set in a fairy tale forest. Battle corrupted creatures with your trusty crossbow and lay clever traps for your foes. But beware the night, for the setting sun heralds the coming of the Beast...
